one_line: Julaha-weaver mystic poet of Varanasi whose nirguna songs crossed caste and community lines.

appearance.age_look: Early 50s, lean and wiry, with the quiet strength of a lifelong craftsman.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown North Indian complexion, sun-lined but calm; straight nose, high cheekbones, neatly trimmed grey beard and moustache framing a gentle, thoughtful gaze; default expression serene, with a hint of wry intensity as if mid-doha.
appearance.hair: Short, straight grey hair kept modestly cropped and combed back, partly visible beneath a simple off-white cotton skullcap tied snugly around the head, the cap edge sitting just above the eyebrows.
appearance.costume: Loose long-sleeved cotton kurta in undyed off-white reaching to mid-thigh, with a simple round neckline; over it a sleeveless dark indigo woven vest referencing his weaver craft; plain cotton dhoti in soft cream wrapped securely to the ankles with clean folds; a narrow, faded marigold-yellow cotton angavastra draped over both shoulders and hanging in front; bare forearms with a simple thread bracelet on the right wrist; utilitarian leather sandals with thong straps; no royal ornaments, only a small wooden bead mala worn doubled around the neck, beads matte and medium brown.
appearance.signature: A handloom shuttle carved from warm brown wood, sized to fit his palm, with a hint of indigo thread wound around it, which he holds lightly in his right hand as both tool and symbol.

ref_desc: Kabir is a lean, medium-brown, grey-haired mystic in off-white kurta, cream dhoti, indigo vest, marigold angavastra and leather sandals, wearing a wooden bead mala and cotton skullcap, holding a brown handloom shuttle wrapped with indigo thread in a calm, intense pose.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Kabir as a dignified 15th-century julaha-weaver poet from Varanasi: a lean, early-50s man with a medium-brown North Indian complexion, oval face, straight nose, high cheekbones, and a neatly trimmed grey beard and moustache, his short grey hair partly covered by a simple off-white cotton skullcap tied snugly around his head. Show his eyes large and thoughtful, with a serene default expression carrying a hint of wry intensity, as if reciting verses. He wears a modest, long-sleeved, undyed off-white cotton kurta reaching to mid-thigh, simple round neckline, and over it a sleeveless dark indigo woven vest that subtly references his weaving craft. His lower garment is a plain cream cotton dhoti wrapped securely down to the ankles in clean, realistic folds, and a narrow marigold-yellow cotton angavastra is draped over both shoulders, hanging in front. Add a small wooden bead mala doubled around his neck, a thread bracelet on his right wrist, and simple brown leather sandals on his feet. Place his signature wooden handloom shuttle in his right hand, sized to his palm, with a small length of indigo thread wound around it, held gently but purposefully. Use a palette dominated by off-white, indigo, cream, marigold yellow, and warm brown, and show him from multiple angles to clearly display his face, skullcap, hair, kurta, vest, dhoti, angavastra, sandals, mala, and shuttle in consistent detail.
